newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo corn futures end mixed, erasing early gains.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo corn futures end mixed, erasing early gains.

text.p: Tokyo corn futures ended mixed on Tuesday, erasing earlier gains, as individual investors hesitated to continue to buy following Monday's price rallies, traders said.
The benchmark March 1998 contract closed 30 yen weaker at 16,310 yen per tonne. The day's volume was 63,431 lots.

Most contracts gained in early trading, reflecting the stronger Chicago market overnight and the yen's falls against the dollar, traders said. "Investors were reluctant to continue to buy, and some months had technical selling," a brokerage house trader said.
